def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    n_steps = 60
    dt = duration_s / (n_steps - 1)

    points = np.empty((n_runs, n_steps, 3), dtype=float)
    lat = np.full(n_runs, start[0], dtype=float)
    lon = np.full(n_runs, start[1], dtype=float)
    t = np.linspace(0, duration_s, n_steps)

    points[:, 0, 0] = lat
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0

    # Backtracking assumed north along last trail walked.
    # Step direction: north (bearing = 0 rad).
    bearing = 0

    # Compute offset in degrees for 1 meter north:
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon

    for i in range(1, n_steps):
        elev0 = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        elev1 = terrain.elev(lat + 1 / m_lat, lon)  # 1 deg north offset approx for slope calc

        d_elev = elev1 - elev0
        d_horiz = 1  # approx 1 meter step horizontal for Toebler speed input (will rescale)

        speed_ms = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev, 1)  # speed for 1m horiz step
        step_m = speed_ms * dt

        # Move step_m meters north
        dlat = step_m / m_lat
        dlon = np.zeros_like(dlat)
        lat_new = lat + dlat
        lon_new = lon + dlon

        # Clamp to terrain box
        lat_new, lon_new = terrain.clamp(lat_new, lon_new)

        lat = lat_new
        lon = lon_new

        points[:, i, 0] = lat
        points[:, i, 1] = lon
        points[:, i, 2] = t[i]

    ok = terrain.inside(points[:, -1, 0], points[:, -1, 1])
    return points, ok
